en.name: Water caltrop
en.summary: Water caltrop is the horned black seed of an aquatic plant, sold raw in the shell in autumn and usually boiled before eating. Raw in the shell it keeps about 1–2 weeks in the fridge. No agency publishes a figure for it, so that range is borrowed from fresh bamboo shoots, the closest fresh starchy shoot available.
en.pantry: Water caltrop is a fresh, wet, starchy seed and a warm room suits it badly — the shells mould and the kernel inside ferments. There is no published counter-storage time, and none is worth improvising. Keep raw ones cold, and treat boiled ones as the cooked starchy food they are: back in the fridge within two hours, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: Keep raw horns dry and loose in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below — not sealed in a bag, because they mould at every point where two shells touch and trap moisture. About 1–2 weeks is the working range, borrowed from fresh bamboo shoots rather than published for water caltrop. Boiled water caltrop, which is how most of it is sold in Taiwan, is a different matter: cool it quickly, refrigerate it, and eat it within a few days.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for raw water caltrop. Freezing raw horns in the shell achieves little; the shell does not soften and the kernel goes grainy. The practical route, if you want to keep a quantity, is to boil and shell them first and freeze the kernels, which behave like any other cooked starch — good in soups and braises, softer in texture than fresh.
en.thawing: Thaw boiled, shelled kernels in the fridge or drop them straight from frozen into a soup or braise. Do not leave them to thaw on the counter.
spoilage: White or green mould where the horns have been touching each other
A shell that gives under thumb pressure instead of feeling hard and dense
A sour or fermented smell when you crack one open
A kernel that is grey, shrunken or slimy rather than white and firm
tips: Buy horns that feel heavy for their size with glossy, unbroken shells.
Spread them out in an open box rather than sealing them in a bag.
Crack one open before buying a large bag; the outside tells you very little.
Boiled water caltrop is a cooked starch — refrigerate it promptly and finish it quickly.

faq.q: How long does raw water caltrop last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 1–2 weeks kept dry and loose. That range is borrowed from fresh bamboo shoots; there is no published figure for water caltrop.

faq.q: How long does boiled water caltrop keep?
faq.a: It is a cooked starchy food, so cool it fast, refrigerate it and eat it within a few days.
There is no timeline for raw ones and freezing them in the shell works poorly. Boil, shell and freeze the kernels instead.

faq.q: Why do water caltrops go mouldy so fast?
faq.a: They are wet where they touch. Sealed in a bag the trapped moisture starts mould at the contact points, so store them loose and dry.

zh.name: 菱角
zh.summary: 菱角是水生菱屬植物帶角的黑色果實，秋天以生的帶殼狀態販售，通常煮熟才吃。生的帶殼菱角冷藏大約可放 1～2 週。沒有機構為它發表過數字，這個範圍是比照新鮮竹筍來看的——那是資料中最接近的新鮮澱粉質嫩莖。
zh.pantry: 菱角是新鮮、含水又富含澱粉的果實，室溫對它非常不利——殼會發霉，裡面的仁會發酵。目前沒有已發表的常溫天數，也不值得自己憑空補一個。生的請冷藏；煮熟的就把它當成一般的熟澱粉食物：兩小時內回冰箱，廚房超過 32 °C 時縮短為一小時。
zh.fridge: 生菱角請保持乾燥、鬆散地放在 4 °C 以下的冰箱裡——不要密封在袋子裡，因為兩顆殼相貼、把濕氣悶住的地方就會開始發霉。大約 1～2 週是合理的上限，這是比照新鮮竹筍來看的，不是針對菱角發表的數字。台灣市面上多半賣的是煮熟的菱角，那是另一回事：快速放涼、冷藏，並在幾天內吃完。
zh.freezer: 生菱角沒有冷凍期限。連殼生凍意義不大，殼不會變軟，仁的口感也會變粉。真的要保存一批，比較實際的做法是先煮熟剝殼再冷凍菱角仁，之後就當成一般的熟澱粉使用——煮湯、滷菜都可以，只是口感比新鮮的軟。
zh.thawing: 煮熟剝殼的菱角仁請放冷藏解凍，或直接從冷凍下鍋煮湯、燉煮。不要放在室溫解凍。
spoilage: 菱角互相接觸的地方長出白色或綠色的霉
殼用拇指一壓就凹陷，而不是硬實有重量
剝開時聞到酸味或發酵味
菱角仁發灰、萎縮或黏滑，而不是白且結實
tips: 挑同樣大小裡比較沉手、殼面光亮沒有破裂的。
攤開放在開口的盒子裡，不要密封進袋子。
買一大袋前先剝一顆看看，外觀看不出裡面的狀況。
煮熟的菱角就是熟澱粉，要盡快冷藏並盡快吃完。

faq.q: 生菱角放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 保持乾燥、鬆散擺放大約 1～2 週。這個範圍是比照新鮮竹筍來看的，菱角本身沒有已發表的數字。

faq.q: 煮熟的菱角可以放多久？
faq.a: 它是熟的澱粉類食物，請快速放涼、冷藏，並在幾天內吃完。
生的沒有對應期限，帶殼冷凍效果也差。建議先煮熟剝殼，再冷凍菱角仁。

faq.q: 菱角為什麼那麼容易發霉？
faq.a: 因為相接觸的地方會潮濕。密封在袋子裡，悶住的水氣會從接觸點開始長霉，所以請鬆散乾燥地存放。
